decisions.reason: As a recently launched industrial niche item with limited but still open-ended market feedback, it is cheap to keep available for another year while demand uncertainty resolves, though its lighter website prominence makes it somewhat more droppable than the others.

A ceiling or floor pipe bracket is close to the firm’s core metal-fabrication capabilities, and after only one year the option value of staying in the market is high relative to the likely low cost of maintaining it.

A pipe support bracket fits the established product logic of the firm, and with uncertainty still high and continuation costs likely modest, management would usually preserve the option rather than abandon it this early.
